title: PUT /media/{id} – request
description: The text fields of a multipart/form-data body; next to them a part named file holds the JPEG itself (image/jpeg), so that part is not in this schema. The server hashes the file and checks it against sha256, and for a photo of a chain entry also against the sha256 of the entry's payload; a mismatch is 422 validation_failed. Sending the same file again is not an error (200). A photo of a scan or incident: only after its entry is accepted, otherwise 404 not_found; only the device that wrote the entry, otherwise 403 forbidden; a revoked device until it closes its upload (api/sync-push-final.request). A checkpoint photo: sent before the checkpoint request that refers to it (photo_media_id), so the checkpoint need not exist yet; supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). A file over the server's limit is 413 bad_request. Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 200, api/media-upload.response.json.

owner_id.description: ID of the scan, incident or checkpoint the photo belongs to.

taken_at.description: When the shutter was pressed, by the device clock.
